entry.name: funnel
entry.digest: Tag data with its inlet number
entry.description: Identifies the inlet of incoming data. It can be used to store values into a table or coll based on their source, or used to set a destination with an object such as spray.

arguments.name: inlets
arguments.description: The first argument sets the number of inlets in the. If there is no argument there will be two inlets.

arguments.name: offset
arguments.description: The second argument specifies an offset for the first inlet number. If no second argument is present, the inlets are numbered beginning with 0.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: In any inlet: The number of the inlet and the stored (most recently received) number in that inlet are sent out as a two-item list.

messages.name: float
messages.description: In any inlet: The number of the inlet and the received number are sent out as a list.

messages.name: int
messages.description: In any inlet: The number of the inlet and the received number are sent out as a list.

messages.name: list
messages.description: In any inlet: The number of the inlet is prepended to the list, and the new list is sent out. In a list floats are not converted to ints. The list may contain ints, floats, and symbols (provided that the first element of the list is not a symbol).

messages.name: offset
messages.description: The wordfollowed by a number will offset the numbering of inlets by the number given.

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Store the data with no output
messages.description: In any inlet: The wordfollowed by a list of numbers which correspond with the number of inlets, will set the input list of numbers without sending them through the outputs.
